_comments: Example ShuttleTerm config. On first launch the app copies shuttleterm.default.json to ~/.shuttleterm.json.
hosts is an array of host objects and optional group objects.
A group is { "Work": [ {host}, {host} ] } and becomes a menubar submenu.
Edit hosts in Settings (Host list, Add Group, Group field on a host), or edit this JSON.
focus_on_hover, reconnect, restore_windows (coding-agent sessions resume), launch_at_login
lock_after_sleep: hide terminals after sleep or screen lock until Touch ID or password
cmd        command to run (usually ssh user@host)
after      optional command sent after the session starts
startup    true opens this host when ShuttleTerm launches
title      optional window title (defaults to name)
reconnect  optional true/false; omit to use the app setting
